Hello Neelesh,

That combination works, and it needs no payment from you. The Hammer BC04 is $249.00 and the Miner Duster is $39.99, so $288.99 against the $299.99 you paid for the NerdQX. Nothing to top up, and nothing comes back either way.

On timing: the BC04 is on the shelf at our Brampton warehouse and ships within 2 business days. The Miner Duster is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by October 29, 2026, so the duster is the part you would wait on.

I am sorry this has dragged on. Your NerdQX reached us on September 24 and you should have had the replacement settled well before now. The last thing it needs is the sign-off on the RMA, which I have put in front of the team with exactly what you have chosen. They are offline until 10am Eastern today and will pick it up then, and the confirmation comes to you by email, so there is nothing for you to send again.

Your Harlo B30 with the free Power Kit is still on for October 15, and you can follow that shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Regards,
Sarah
